samples.question: This image shows five framed rectangular panels of identical size standing side by side, numbered panel-1 to panel-5 from left to right. Every panel contains exactly five horizontal coloured bars drawn one above another at five fixed heights. Read every bar as the horizontal stretch it covers between its left end and its right end; the height, thickness, colour and vertical position of a bar never carry information, and bars in different panels are never compared. Two bars of the same panel are separate when their stretches do not touch at all, nested when one stretch lies entirely inside the other, and crossing when the stretches overlap while neither one lies entirely inside the other. In exactly one panel every pair of bars is separate or nested, so that panel holds no crossing pair; each of the other four panels holds at least one crossing pair, and every overlap, gap and nesting margin in the image is at least sixteen pixels wide, so no pair is a close call. Every panel holds five bars and nearly the same total bar length, and bar colours are dealt at random, so bar count, colour, size and total ink can never identify the panel. Which numbered panel contains no crossing pair of bars? Answer with exactly one of: panel-1, panel-2, panel-3, panel-4, panel-5.
